meta.name: Maaya 720p
meta.description: When Sonia has a nervous breakdown and forgets the last 6 months of her life, her husband, Abhishek, is forced to dig into her life to find out what had caused the trauma.

videos.title: Beginning of the End
videos.overview: Sonia is devastated by an unknown emotional trauma to slip into a coma. While her doctor husband Abhishek tried to uncover the truth. In the meanwhile, Rahul pays the price of a bad marriage.

videos.title: Both Slaves
videos.overview: Rahul begins to spill the beans to his lawyer. Talks about his sad life and BDSM the only refuge. Sonia learns of her condition while Abhishek digs deeper to uncover her trauma. Maaya, a brand.

videos.title: Hi Maaya!
videos.overview: Abhishek delves into Sonia’s past to begin a journey of uncovering her secrets. Rahul in the meanwhile begins to reveal to his lawyers the darkness of his marriage.

videos.title: And They Met
videos.overview: Rahul reveals to his lawyer why his wife is upset with him and how he managed to find Maaya. Abhishek in the meanwhile discovers that Sonia is losing track of time and he needs to know her secret in a hurry.

videos.title: The Five Percent
videos.overview: Rahul is finally able to convince Sonia to meet him. Sonia is skittish. Rahul has a way out for her to get to know him. Sonia’s perilous journey descent into the dark world begins.

videos.title: The Body Has a Mind of its Own
videos.overview: Rahul sends Sonia a barrage of BDSM fantasies. Sonia is fighting her body and her fantasies. The battle reaches its climax.

videos.title: A Slave to Love
videos.overview: Abhishek tries to avoid his surgeries as he continues reading the blog. Sonia and Rahul's relationship intensifies from BDSM to something much more.

videos.title: The Chains of Society
videos.overview: Maaya is torn apart between her love for Rahul and Abhishek’s love for her while things worsen for Rahul as he gets further caught up in his father-in-law’s ugly ways.

videos.title: Half A Heart
videos.overview: Sonia tries to cope up when she gets the news about Rahul’s injuries. Rahul finally understands the conspiracy against him.

videos.title: The Long Night
videos.overview: Abhishek has no choice but to tell Sonia the truth about Maaya. Rahul has to fight to prove his innocence.

videos.title: Odd Couple
videos.overview: Ruhi Ahuja and Simmi Sood cross paths till they cannot help but be drawn to each other. Ruhi tries to show Simmi the mirror to her real self but Simmi lashes out at her and turns away.

videos.title: Passing Magic
videos.overview: Ruhi and Simmi cannot help it as their attraction grows but Puneet proves to be a constant thorn in their side.

videos.title: Strangers Again
videos.overview: Simmi gives Ruhi a glimpse into her life with her parents leaving them at a crossroads. Simmi tries to talk to Puneet but he lashes out at her.

videos.title: Giving Up
videos.overview: Simmi feels defeated by her circumstances and decides to take drastic measures to fix things. Ruhi asks Beena for her help.

videos.title: Hit Back
videos.overview: Beena brings in Shanaya to help them get rid of Puneet but Simmi is apprehensive of the plan to get him out of the way. Ruhi is suspicious of Shanaya as her loyalty seems blurry.

videos.title: Season of Love
videos.overview: Puneet wakes up to find out that he has been played. Simmi and Ruhi share some romantic and intimate moments. Puneet decides to go all out to get out and take his revenge.

videos.title: Twilight Zone
videos.overview: Ruhi, Simmi, Beena and Shanaya are ready to celebrate their victory when things take a turn for the worse. Puneet threatens Simmi and is hell bent on exacting revenge.

videos.title: Cat & Mouse
videos.overview: Simmi is plagued by fear after Puneet’s threat. Things get heated up as Puneet’s violence increases.

videos.title: No Escape
videos.overview: Puneet begins to blackmail Ruhi and Simmi into doing his bidding. They are forced to succumb to his threats.

videos.title: Almost There
videos.overview: Ruhi decides to take matters into her own hands. Simmi, Ruhi and Beena come close to uncovering important evidence.

videos.title: Enemy of Love
videos.overview: Simmi comes to a crossroads and the tables turn on them as Puneet plays his trump card against them.

videos.title: End Game
videos.overview: Ruhi and Simmi play a final game of pitch and toss to save their relationship and the people around them.

videos.title: Upheaval
videos.overview: Sonica Sangha enters Aakash Arora's world by storm. Aakash is blown away by the film star only to realise that she is his son's girlfriend. Destiny brings Aakash and Sonica together as he sets out to save her life.

videos.title: And Then There Were Two
videos.overview: Aakash is concerned about Sonica's careless attitude towards herself. She has given up on life but Aakash is determined to save her live and her from herself.

videos.title: Say It Again
videos.overview: Sonica's world changes when Aakash decides to save her life. Together they set out on a journey that not only brings them closer but sets the stage for inevitable love.

videos.title: Life and Death
videos.overview: Aakash is unable to deal with what he feels for Sonica and the lies he has to feed his family begins to get to him. Meanwhile Aarav becomes a man of substance and begins to care for Sonica like never before.

videos.title: Price Of Life
videos.overview: Sonica and Aakash are at odds about where their relationship stands. Both need to face their demons. To be together felt wrong, not to be together felt even worse.

videos.title: Two Becomes One
videos.overview: Love eventually finds its way. Sonica and AaKash begin to accept what they truly feel. Whoever said love was easy?

videos.title: Loves Me, Loves Me Not
videos.overview: Every relationship has to go through the test of time and Aakash and Sonica are no exceptions. There secret affair is in danger of being found out and their lives are about to change forever.

videos.title: Broken Hearts
videos.overview: The news of the love affair between Sonica and Aakash hits every news channel and their world as they know it is shattered. Aarav is heartbroken, Kaamya is devastated and there lives change in the blink of an eye.

videos.title: Shattered
videos.overview: Four lives stand shattered as Sonica, Aakash, Kaamya and Aarav come to terms with what has happened.

videos.title: Love and Lies
videos.overview: The cancer is back and Sonica tries to push Aakash away to save him from having to lose her. The series finale sees a love saga unfold as Aakash and Sonica are faced with the possibility of broken hearts or a bright new future.
